summary.text: Yin Wind Ghost Sickle Hand is Wu Yong's immortal killer move that forms an enormous yin wind ghost hand with sickle claws.

claims.text: After Fang Yuan’s reverse flow protection seal sends Finger Wind Dragon back at Wu Yong, Wu Yong finishes the immortal killer move he has been preparing and activates Yin Wind Ghost Sickle Hand. He stretches out his right arm and grabs toward the dragon; almost instantly, with no prior indication, an enormous pitch black ghost hand formed completely of yin wind appears on the dragon’s body, with long sharp claws like five sickles, and grabs it like an earthworm. The dragon cries out, struggles, and after several breaths breaks apart into gusts of wind that dissipate. Feng Jiu Ge turns solemn: Finger Wind Dragon is a rank eight killer move, yet yin wind ghost sickle hand clearly appears much more powerful, and a grab on him would have been too miserable to imagine. Wu Yong had prepared the move for a long while to defeat Feng Jiu Ge; Fang Yuan’s interference forced him to spend it on the reflected dragon instead.

The move has a subsequent transformation called yin wind rope whose ability is to capture Gu Immortals. Wu Yong spent large effort and immortal essence preparing yin wind ghost sickle hand to capture Feng Jiu Ge alive, seeking a boost to his fame and Southern Border righteous path influence, avoiding a full falling out with Central Continent and Heavenly Court, and gaining leverage to extort Spirit Affinity House and even Heavenly Court for Immortal Gu taken from the super Gu formation.
On Heavenly Court’s battlefield Wu Yong alternates yin wind rope with wishful wind whip, soft vajra wind chief, and other killer moves to tie down enemies.
